prompt.zh-TW: 晨光健身房沒有存貨，應收帳款也很少，但總資產週轉率只有 {{number:vars.turnover|digits=2,unit=times}}。最可能的原因是什麼？
prompt.en: Morning Light Gym holds no inventory and has very few receivables, yet its total asset turnover is only {{number:vars.turnover|digits=2,unit=times}}. What is the most likely reason?

text.zh-TW: 錢大多投在器材和裝潢，這些都算在分母裡，一年營收相較之下不大
text.en: Most of the money is in equipment and fit-out, which sit in the denominator, so a year’s revenue looks small beside them

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。先看分母裝了什麼：器材和裝潢占了資產的大半。{{number:vars.turnover|digits=2,unit=times}}算不算低，要拿其他健身房的數字來對照才知道。
feedback.en: That’s right. Look first at what sits in the denominator: equipment and fit-out make up most of the assets. Whether {{number:vars.turnover|digits=2,unit=times}} is low only becomes clear when you set it beside other gyms.

text.zh-TW: 一定是算錯了，沒有存貨的公司總資產週轉率應該很高
text.en: It must be a mistake; a company with no inventory should have a high total asset turnover

feedback.zh-TW: 你想到存貨會拉低週轉率，這在零售業很常見。不過總資產不只有存貨，健身房的器材和裝潢才是大頭，所以數字沒有算錯。
feedback.en: You thought of inventory dragging turnover down, which is common in retail. But total assets are not just inventory; for a gym the equipment and fit-out are the bulk, so the figure is not a mistake.

text.zh-TW: 總資產週轉率低表示會員付款太慢
text.en: Low total asset turnover means members are paying too slowly

feedback.zh-TW: 會員付款快慢反映在應收款項週轉率；題目說應收帳款很少，所以付款速度不是原因。
feedback.en: How quickly members pay shows up in receivables turnover; receivables here are small, so payment speed is not the cause.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_2cqt9cfd}}的分母是{{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}}。健身房沒有存貨、應收帳款也少，資產幾乎都是要用上好幾年的器材和裝潢，一年的營收和它們相比自然顯得小。{{option:o_0170}}從分母的內容找原因；{{option:o_8y87}}只想到存貨，{{option:o_41a1}}找錯了指標。
explanation.en: The denominator of {{term:tm_2cqt9cfd}} is {{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}}. With no inventory and few receivables, a gym’s assets are almost all equipment and fit-out that last for years, so one year’s revenue looks small beside them. {{option:o_0170}} finds the reason in what the denominator holds; {{option:o_8y87}} thinks only of inventory, and {{option:o_41a1}} looks at the wrong ratio.
